The API SLA risk calculator implementation achieved a perfect verifier reward of 1.00 with all tests passing in the initial iteration.
The run succeeded with 0 exceptions and a mean reward of 1.000 across 1 trial. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with zero failed or skipped tests. While the logic for weighted risk assessment is functional, future iterations should verify edge cases in the SLA calculation formula to ensure robustness against extreme input values.
